subject: RedfishPkg/RedfishHttpDxe: Improve RedfishHttpOperation error handling
reasons: This is a one-off bug fix in a single function (ParseResponseMessage) in a single file, adding proper error handling when CreateRedfishPayload returns NULL.
The fix is context-specific: it adds a goto ON_ERROR after a particular NULL check in a specific function flow. There is no repeated pattern across multiple files or call sites.
One-off, context-sensitive bug fixes with case-by-case reasoning are explicitly not good Coccinelle candidates.
